correctness.rationale: The normalized ground-state PDE is derived exactly; multiplying by spatially weighted h-prime, integrating by parts and using AbU=BcV cancels the sole indefinite cross term. Scalar logistic upper comparisons prove uniform boundedness and global existence; dissipation integrates squared L2 deviations over infinite time, time regularity makes these deviations tend to zero and parabolic spatial compactness upgrades to uniform convergence. value.rationale: The 2026 construction shows an intrinsic qualitative issue: uniquely coexisting heterogeneous predator–prey populations can oscillate. The pointwise ratio matching gives a transparent sharp-design sufficient structural condition for a strict nonlinear Lyapunov functional, global attraction and exclusion of all positive recurrent oscillations at all positive diffusivities. It permits distinct nonconstant equilibrium profiles and everywhere negative m, not a homogeneous or mere low-diffusion textbook consequence; a fully explicit biologically meaningful example verifies nonvacuity.
